# Panda Protect

> Panda Protect is a UK trade warranty programme for motor dealers. Approved dealerships quote, sell and manage comprehensive used-vehicle warranties for their customers through the Panda Protect dealer portal.

Key facts:
- Business-to-business only: cover is sold through approved UK motor dealers, not directly to private buyers.
- Cover: Comprehensive Warranty (Platinum plan) for cars, vans, EVs, hybrids and motorcycles up to 15 years old and 150,000 miles.
- Terms of 1 to 4 years; dealers set their own retail price and keep the margin.
- UK team open 9am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday. Purchases: support@pandaprotect.co.uk. Claims: claims@pandaprotect.co.uk.
